visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'GRID BORDERS' look for content cards. Flat solid dark surfaces (#111111) with 1px border-white/10. NO heavy glassmorphism for content cards (keeps it raw and mechanical). Use 'Crystal Glass' ONLY for sticky nav and floating CTAs (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire background to emulate raw metal/workshop feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Remove standard drop shadows on cards. Rely on 1px borders and background contrast for depth. Use soft gold drop-shadows only for hover states on primary CTAs.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-24. Top-level page sections must have py-24 or py-32 minimum.
grids_layouts.services_grid: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid. gap-6. Mix col-span-full, col-span-1, row-span-2. Never symmetric squares. Push negative space.

responsive.layout: Stack grid items on mobile (grid-cols-1). Shift to complex bento/asymmetry on md/lg. Keep heavy/decorative visuals from dominating the mobile viewport.
responsive.typography: Mobile H1 scales to text-4xl max. Body text minimum 16px to prevent zoom. Headings must use fluid clamp sizes.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure overflow-x-hidden on the main app wrapper. Constrain flex/grid children to prevent unintended horizontal scrolling.
responsive.tap_targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] for all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs). Keep floating WhatsApp in bottom thumb-zone.

motion_interactions.hero_load: Framer Motion masked line-by-line text reveal on H1 ('COMPLETE ROYAL ENFIELD CARE'). Subtle scale down (1.05 to 1) and slow fade on hero background image.
motion_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling (MANDATORY). Add framer-motion viewport reveals for scroll entrances.
motion_interactions.hover: Subtle translation (-translate-y-1) + border color shift to gold_muted. No bouncy, generic scale-ups.
motion_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon using react-fast-marquee. Gap-32, text-sm tracking-widest, pale gold text on dark background ('METICULOUS MAINTENANCE • CUSTOM FABRICATION • ENGINE TUNING').

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Dark background, gold border, hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black transition-colors.
components.booking_form: Shadcn based. Progressive disclosure (Step-by-step UX). Minimal fields per view. Mobile-friendly sticky CTA.
components.navigation: Sticky nav with backdrop-blur-xl. Desktop visible links. Hamburger ONLY on mobile.
components.floating_actions: WhatsApp and Call buttons fixed in bottom-right corner (z-50). Gold icons, dark glass background.
components.faq_accordion: Shadcn accordion. Sharp borders, gold accents on open state.

accessibility.contrast: APCA minimums. Text over images MUST have gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/60 to-transparent).
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.

icons_library: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight preferred for high-end luxury feel).

3d_creative_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for UI choreography and scroll reveals. Use react-fast-marquee for editorial ribbons.
3d_creative_libraries.usage: Rely on rich parallaxing photography and kinetic typography rather than complex 3D canvas libraries to ensure performance.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic uniform styling.
DO NOT use pure white backgrounds; this is a strictly dark-theme luxury experience. Use #050505 as base.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout structures; avoid Shadcn layout cards as they are too rigid for creative asymmetry.
USE Shadcn heavily for the Booking Form, customized to match the dark metallic theme.
Ensure 'mobile-first' strategy: single columns, touch-friendly CTAs in thumb-zone, legible fonts on mobile.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Apply data-testid to every clickable element (buttons, links, form inputs).
Hero image must have gradient overlay (bg-black/50 or bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/40 to-transparent) so white/gold text is perfectly readable.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for premium feel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) strictly for nav/floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp edges for this project) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (Note: use .js/.jsx extensions, not .tsx)
